evidence_boundary: Recoverability metadata is a hint contract. It does not authorize execution, replace policy engines, prove safety, or certify production readiness. SMERC or another runtime still has to validate and decide.

work_result_impact.impact: If this small contract becomes normal, larger SMERC scoring gets cleaner inputs instead of guessing recoverability from logs after the fact.
work_result_impact.result: MCP tools, GitHub Actions, AWS-style actions, and other runtimes can describe rollback, side effects, blast radius, evidence, isolation boundaries, and posture hints before execution.
work_result_impact.work: Define the smallest recoverability metadata shape for individual tool calls and automation actions.
